note: ภาพหน้าแรก 4 ชั้นสำหรับ parallax สร้างด้วย AI โดยทีม แล้วลบพื้นสีม่วงชมพูออกเป็นพื้นใส (WebP)
size: 1774x887 ทุกชั้น วางซ้อนกันชิดล่าง
process: ลบพื้น #FF00FF ด้วยการคำนวณความโปร่งใสจากระดับสีม่วงชมพู, ย้ายชั้นฟ้าขึ้นให้พระอาทิตย์อยู่เหนือภูเขา, ย่อชั้นภูเขาไกลให้กว้างเท่ากัน, เติมฐานภูเขาไกล/กลางด้วยสีหมอกสีเดียวจนถึงขอบล่าง
master: Wide 2:1 landscape illustration of northern Thailand at sunrise, seen as clear separate depth layers. Back to front: soft morning sky with a warm orange sun low on the right and a few soft clouds; a thin line of distant sea at the horizon with very pale misty mountain ridges; sage-green rolling mountains with a band of white morning mist at their base and a small golden Thai chedi (pagoda) on a hilltop slightly right of center; dark forest-green hills in the foreground with silhouettes of pine and tropical trees. Style: flat vector-like illustration with subtle soft painterly texture, calm and airy, strong atmospheric perspective (farther = paler and bluer). Limited palette: forest green #2F5D46, sage #7FA77A, mint mist #B7D3C0, sky #CFE6EF and #8EC5DB, sunrise orange #F08A3C, off-white #F3F6F0. Keep the most important shapes in the middle 40% of the width. No text, no people, no logos, no watermark, no frame.

layers.sky.webp: Using the attached image, recreate ONLY the sky layer: the morning sky, the orange sun and the clouds, filling the whole canvas. Remove all mountains, sea, mist, trees and the pagoda; continue the sky naturally where they were. Same size, same style, same colors, same sun position.
layers.far.webp: Using the attached image, recreate ONLY the farthest layer: the distant sea line and the very pale misty mountain ridges, in exactly the same position, scale and colors as in the reference. Everything else (sky, sun, clouds, nearer mountains, mist, pagoda, trees) must be replaced by a solid flat #FF00FF magenta background. The bottom of the layer must extend solid down to the bottom edge of the canvas. Same canvas size.
layers.mid.webp: Using the attached image, recreate ONLY the middle layer: the sage-green mountains, the white mist band at their base and the golden chedi on the hilltop, in exactly the same position, scale and colors as in the reference. Everything else (sky, sun, sea, far ridges, foreground forest) must be a solid flat #FF00FF magenta background. The layer must extend solid down to the bottom edge of the canvas. Same canvas size.
layers.near.webp: Using the attached image, recreate ONLY the foreground layer: the dark forest-green hills and the tree silhouettes, in exactly the same position, scale and colors as in the reference. Everything else must be a solid flat #FF00FF magenta background. The layer must reach the bottom edge of the canvas. Same canvas size.
